name: University of Sydney
summary: Camperdown/Darlington campus with residential colleges next to it; degrees from Arts and Commerce to Science, Advanced Computing and Engineering.

ib.text: Entry is on your total IB score, converted to an ATAR equivalent. 2027 totals: Arts 26, Science 29, Advanced Computing 34, Engineering 31, Commerce 38, Physiotherapy 40. Maths and science are assumed, not required.

apply.via: Direct to Sydney (UAC only for IB studied in Australia)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Advanced Computing
programmes.about: A four-year computing degree where you complete a major in Computer Science, Computational Data Science, Cybersecurity or Software Development, and can add a second major or a minor from a shared pool of 100+ majors.
programmes.ib: 2027 entry needs 34 IB points. Maths Extension 1 (HSC level) is assumed; the formal maths prerequisite does not apply to an IB taken outside Australia.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your total IB score against the published figure (2027 entry guide, indicative).

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Advanced Computing: four computing majors, 100+ shared majors, an engineering and technology precinct

programmes.name: Bachelor of Commerce
programmes.about: A business degree built on one major, such as Finance, Marketing, Accounting or Business Analytics, plus a second major or minor and open-learning units. Combines with Computing, Engineering, Law or Science.
programmes.ib: 2027 entry needs 38 IB points. Mathematics Standard or higher is assumed, depending on the majors you choose.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your total IB score against the published figure (2027 entry guide, indicative).

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Commerce: a major from 12 areas plus a second major or minor, combinable with five other degrees

faculties.name: Arts and social sciences
faculties.line: Bachelor of Arts needs IB 26; Media and Communications 34, International Studies 31. No subject is required.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: Commerce needs IB 38, Economics 31. Maths Standard or higher is assumed.

faculties.name: Engineering and computer science
faculties.line: Engineering Honours needs IB 31, Advanced Computing 34. Maths Extension 1 is assumed; Physics or Chemistry for engineering.

faculties.name: Medicine and health
faculties.line: Biomedicine and Health needs IB 34, Physiotherapy 40.

faculties.name: Architecture, design and planning
faculties.line: Design in Architecture needs IB 34; Architecture and Environments 29. Assumed knowledge is English Advanced.

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Science needs IB 29, Science (Advanced) 34; assumed knowledge depends on your majors.

faculties.name: Sydney Conservatorium of Music
faculties.line: Music needs IB 24 plus an audition or interview.

notes: Most international students, IB students outside Australia included, apply directly; UAC is only for an IB Diploma taken in Australia.
Applications open two years ahead and close earlier once a course is full, so apply early.
Totals are indicative and subject to change; your course page has the latest figure.
